Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then. 4 done, 4 won! The Aussies are surely warming up well leading up to the World Cup. They would love to make this a clean sweep and make it 5-0 come Sunday. The match will be played at the same venue. That game will begin at 1500 local (1100 GMT) on the 31st of March. See you then. Take care and cheers!

Aaron Finch, the victorious Australian skipper feels that their composure with the ball was really good. He states that his team knew that getting two new batsmen out in the middle would make it difficult for Pakistan. He reserves praise for both of Pakistan's ton-makers. Has special praise reserved now for his own team's all-round star, Glenn Maxwell by saying that he is a superstar and he tonks the ball a fair distance. Mentions that he is really pleased with the way how they have won the 4 games in different ways, let it be chasing the score or defending one.

Imad Wasim, the Pakistan skipper feels that the Aussies bowled beautifully in the end and that they lacked the power-hitting ability towards the end. He praises both the centurions and says they both are special talents. About the bowling talent, he reckons there is absolutely nothing wrong with the bowling attack except that they went for 25-30 runs more in the end. Signs off by saying that it was an honor to lead the national side and it was hard luck that they ended on the losing side.

Glenn Maxwell is the Man of the Match. He says that he was happy that it was important to put a good partnership along with Carey in today's game as they did not get much chances to bat in the previous games. He feels that his role in the team is defined solidly and he has clarity. Informs us that he along with his team knew that breaking the big partnership (Abid-Rizwan) was the key and that then they could come back into the match.

Coming to the Australian bowling, they always managed to stay in the game despite two good partnerships. They stuck to the plan and when they broke the 144-run stand, they started gnawing their way back into the game. The pick of the bowlers was Nathan Coulter-Nile but take nothing away from the rest who did really well in conditions where the ball was tough to grip due to dew. Thus, in the end, the match ended with a very small margin and it was Australia who finished on the winning side due to holding their nerves better. The presentation ceremony to follow...

The chase began in poor fashion as the first wicket was lost with nothing on the board but Abid Ali who was the other opener played brilliantly on debut. He got support firstly from Haris Sohail who was slow and steady in a stand of 74. He fell at the wrong time trying to accelerate but Mohammad Rizwan who walked out to replace him looked like a determined man. He along with Abid Ali added 144 runs for the 3rd wicket and ensured Pakistan were in cruise control of the chase. Both of them got to their respective centuries, but both fell at the wrong time and with it being difficult for the new batsmen to come in and whack the ball, the Aussies ensured they won the game by a small margin of 6 runs.

Solemn faces in the stands as well as the Pakistan dressing room but the Australians are mighty pleased and there are high-fives and big smiles going around between the Men in Yellow! Two centuries in the chase but still ending up on the wrong side is surely a tough pill to swallow. Mickey Arthur is bearing a glum look on his face as his team have slipped to the fourth loss in a row but such has been the match that they were practically ruling the game almost till the end and crashed out at the last moment.
A pull from Yasir and a single taken on the last ball. AUSTRALIA WIN THE GAME BY 6 RUNS and take a 4-0 lead in the 5-match ODI series!!!

OUT! That is the game! That surely is it! A shorter length slower ball on middle, Usman pulls it away hard but the deep square leg fielder takes a good catch. Handscomb is not dropping those and he makes sure that this game is over with a ball to be bowled unless it is a no ball or wide. Heartbreak for the hosts but such is the game and Australia were always in the game. Junaid Khan meanwhile, makes his way out to the middle.
SIX! This game is not yet dead! What a strike that is by Usman Khan. Deposits this length ball way over long off for a maximum. What a shot! 8 off 2 now!
Driven to long on for a single by Yasir to get Usman on strike.
Usman Khan walks in next.

OUT! Rizwan holes out and that surely is the final nail in the coffin for Pakistan! A fuller length ball on the pads and Mohammad Rizwan times it pretty well in the air but finds Peter Handscomb at deep square leg. He takes it safely and there are wide glee on the faces of the Aussie fielders now! They will be breathing much easier. End of a good innings by Rizwan but that is still not enough at this stage for his team.
WIDE! That is wild at this moment. Slower one from Marcus way outside leg.
Stoinis starts the last over with a short ball. Yasir Shah slaps it down to long on for a single. Not a bad result for Pakistan. Rizwan is on strike. 16 needed from 5 balls.
Wow. Did not think this would ever happen Marcus Stoinis to bowl the last over and he has got what - 17 to defend. Unbelievable.
What a ball to finish the over! Absolutely cramps the batsman for room and Rizwan only can hit it back to the bowler. 17 runs needed off 6 balls in the last over.
FOUR! Rizwan finally finds the middle of the bat. A much-needed boundary for Pakistan. A short length ball on middle, Rizwan hits it hard over the head of the bowler for a boundary.
This is bad batting! Losing shape at the wrong time is Rizwan. A fuller length ball outside off, Rizwan looks to hit it over cover but fails to put bat on ball.
Yasir Shah walks out to bat next.

OUT! Huge wicket for Australia and Pakistan sink further! A short length ball on top of off stump, Wasim looks to hit it over covers but the ball gets big on him. It flies off the top half and goes to deep point where Shaun Marsh makes no mistake. Good catch under pressure. 21 off 9 is the equation now.
Slower ball on a length outside off, Wasim looks to cut it over extra cover but fails to put bat on ball as he is beaten by the lack of pace.

That is the hundred for Rizwan! His 2nd in ODI cricket, his 2nd in this series itself! A fuller ball outside off, driven to deep cover for a single as he gets to the landmark. The job at hand is a bigger one though, he needs to take his team home.
Kane Richardson to bowl the 49th over.

Length ball on top of off stump, Wasim times it really well but fails to find the gap. 3 runs only off this over and a wicket. What a comeback this has been from Australia! Tightening the noose like a boa constrictor! Coulter-Nile ends with 10-1-53-3. The equation now is 22 of 12.
Short length on top of off stump, Wasim looks to punch it off the back foot but the ball is mistimed to mid off.
Fuller one on middle, driven hard down the ground for a single by Rizwan as he moves onto 99.
Short of a length on middle, Imad pushes it through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air again! But well short of deep mid-wicket. A length ball on middle, Rizwan looks to pull the ball but mistimes it aerially towards the fielder in the deep. A single is taken to bring his skipper on strike.
Imad Wasim, the skipper walks out next to bat.

OUT! Saad Ali holes out in the deep. A half-volley from Nathan Coulter-Nile from around the wicket, Saad looked to hit it over mid on but the bat turned in his hand and goes to Richardson at deep mid-wicket who takes a sitter. Excellent stuff this from Australia. They have put the pressure right back on Pakistan. 25 needed off 17 now. Going to be really a nerve-wracking finish here!
Short and wide outside off, cut away for a single to backward point. 25 needed off 18 balls. Saad will face the next over.

Flatter one on the pads, Saad was down the track and looks to flick it. The ball runs off the pads for a couple of leg byes fine on the leg side. Very lucky! If Saad had missed that ball, he could have been stumped.
Flighted ball on middle, pushed along the ground to long on for a run.
FOUR! That was the boundary Pakistan so badly needed. A flighted ball on the pads, paddled down on the leg side fine. The ball runs really fine and fast to the ropes. Rizwan moves on to 96 now.

Flighted on the pads, Rizwan sweeps it fine on the leg side past short fine leg for a couple of runs. That is excellent running from someone who has kept wickets for 50 overs and has been in the middle for quite some time.
Flatter one on middle, pushed to long on for a single by the southpaw.
Full on off, Rizwan slices it to point. Maxwell dives and saves the run. Equation is 36 off 24.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Saad Ali flicks it stylishly to mid-wicket for a run.
Full on off, Saad drives it to mid off.
A short delivery with just little pace, Rizwan pulls it to square leg. Single added.
Half-volley on off, Saad drives it through the covers for a single.
A good length delivery on off, Rizwan digs it to mid-wicket for a single.
Swept fine on the leg side by Rizwan. Zampa who goes behind the ball fails to pick it clearly but that does not cost an extra run and only a single is taken. 40 off 30 needed now.
Chopped away to deep cover for a couple of runs. That is excellent running.
Short outside off, Rizwan rocks back and looks to open the face of the bat and hit this between point and short third man but he finds the point fielder.

Another shout. Flatter one on the pads, Saad looks to glance it down to fine leg but misses the ball. The ball runs off the pad to fine leg for a leg bye. The ball was surely missing leg stump there so no interest from the umpire.
Back of a length on off, Rizwan rocks back plays it to point for a single.
Full on leg, Rizwan again goes for sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads. A loud appeal by the umpire. Umpire shakes his head. Replays shows there was bat involved.
On a length outside off, pushed back to the bowler by Saad Ali to end the over. 45 runs needed in 36 balls now.
Really full yorker on middle, driven down to long on by Rizwan for a run.
Guided down to third man for a single by the southpaw.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the right of point where Maxwell dives and makes a stop. No run taken.
Saad is off the mark straightaway. Flicked away through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Good running by both batsmen that!
Saad Ali walks out to bat now.

OUT! Played on! Is there a twist in the tale? A length ball outside off, Umar Akmal wanted to slog this over mid-wicket but took his eyes off the ball. He swings but only gets an under edge which goes to disturb the middle stump. This is just what Pakistan would not have wanted. They need to take this deep and win it, cannot afford to give the visitors any space to come back in the game. 49 off 41 is the equation now.
Nathan Coulter-Nile replaces Adam Zampa.
A fuller length on leg, Rizwan comes down the track and flicks it to long on for a double. The equation now is Pakistan need 49 runs in 42 balls.
Maxwell fires this one on off, Akmal taps it to covers for a single.
A full length delivery on middle and leg, Rizwan drives it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Akmal adds another run by punching it.
Maxwell chnages his lines, bowls this on off, Akmal plays it late towards the third man region for a double.
Maxwell begins his spell by bowling this short outside off, Akmal cuts it to point for a double.
Glenn Maxwell to bowl now.

Flatter one on middle, Akmal gets off the mark with a pull over mid-wicket for a run. He keeps strike for the next over. Zampa like his spin twin, ends with figures of 10-0-49-1. 58 from 48 needed now.
Short and on top of off stump, cut away by Umar but he finds the point fielder.
Another quick one darted in on off stump, Akmal pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, pushed by Akmal to cover.
Flatter ball on middle, pulled away for a single to deep mid-wicket by Rizwan. He moves into the 80s with that shot.
Umar Akmal walks out to bat at number 5.

OUT! Abid Ali has lost his focus and his wicket as well! A flighted ball from Zampa on middle and Abid looks to slog it without getting to the ball. He gets a top edge and the ball flies high to Aaron Finch at long on. He is not going to drop those. Huge applause from the crowd, the teammates, coaching staff as Abid makes his way out. That is the end of this exceptional 144-run stand though. Is this the opening for Australia or has the wicket come too late?
Lyon bowls this one short, Ali punches to covers and runs for a single. Nathan Lyon ends his night with figures of 10-0-49-1.
Back of a length delivery on off, Abid plays it very late and just guides it third man Khawaja gives a good chase and just pulls the ball before touching the ropes. Batsmen runs two.
Length delivery on off, Rizwan sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Ali punches it to point. Single added.
A flighted delivery on off, Rizwan steps down and drives it mid off for a single.
A tossed up delivery on off, Rizwan defends it with ease.
Powerplay 3 is upon us now. There can be 5 fielders outside the circle till the end now. The equation is 65 off 60 balls.

NOT OUT! And Australia lose their review. A leg spinner outside off, Abid comes ahead and looks to sweep but misses the ball. The keeper, Carey catches the ball and asks the question. The bowler then joins in the appeal. The umpire though is unmoved. Finch, after a long time, takes it upstairs. The replays show us that the ball was no even close to the bat and there is nothing on the Snickometer. Abid will continue with his merry innings.

Review time! Australia have taken this one upstairs for a caught behind off a sweep attempt by Abid Ali. There was some noise when the ball went through he heard says Ramiz Raja on air. Looked like the ball was pretty far away from the bat to the naked eye though.
FOUR! Another sweep which connects. A length delivery on off, Ali sweeps it towards the square leg region for one bounce four.
A tossed up delivery, Ali gets a top edge towards log on for a double.
Full on leg, Ali sweeps it fine leg for a double.
Another sweep for a single. Full on off, Rizwan drags it from off and plays to fine leg. This is frustrating for Zampa. Every time he bowls well he has been swept.
A flatter delivery on middle and leg, Rizwan dances down the track and hits it straight to the bowler.
Cut away to deep cover for a single. Rizwan keeps strike for the next over.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet by Rizwan! A flighted one on middle, Mohammad comes down the track and smacks this ball past wide long on for a boundary.
Pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Rizwan charges down the wicket to this ball and hits it wristily through mid-wicket. 2 runs picked up.
Beaten! A flatter arm ball outside off, Rizwan comes ahead to drive the ball but is beaten as it holds its line. Good ball but the Aussies need wickets!

HUNDRED FOR ABID ALI! What a sensational innings this has been from the debutant. He pushes this length ball to deep square leg to get to the landmark. A simply mature innings from the not so young debutant. He has showed the Pakistan batsmen how to do it in a chase. The job is not yet done though and he would like to be there till the end.
Flatter one on middle, Mohammad is down the track but just pushes the ball to mid-wicket.
Flatter one on off, Rizwan looks to defend the ball on his front foot but gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Flighted ball on middle, Rizwan comes down the track to lift it over cover but the ball comes of the inner half towards the bowler.
Flatter one on middle, Abid works it away to deep mid-wicket for a single. He moves on to 99.

Not Out! It is just clipping the leg stump and Abid can breathe easy! It is the Umpire's call and hence will remain not out. Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Ali looks to flick but misses it. The ball hits him high on his pads. The Aussies go up in appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Finch takes it upstairs but the Hawk Eye shows the ball just clips the leg stump, that is not enough for them.
Review time... An LBW appeal from the Aussies is turned down. The ball looked to be missing the leg stump or only clipping it at max to the naked eye. Let's see what the replays have to say!
A flighted delivery on off, Rizwan sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Lyon fires this one on off, Mohammad Rizwan just taps it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Rizwan connects sweep this time. A fuller length delivery on middle Rizwan now watchfully sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Full length on off, Rizwan goes for a sweep but fails to connect.
Full on middle and leg, Ali flicks for a single.
Back of a length on off, Ali pushes it to covers.
Floatted delivery on leg, Rizwan comes down the track and drives it to long on for a single.

Drinks break! Pakistan are motoring along beautifully out here. The partnership between Rizwan and Abid is worth an unbeaten 112 runs. Abid Ali is set for a maiden ODI ton in his debut game. The two batsmen have set the platform for victory and with the dew playing a part and the ball coming on nicely to the bat, the hosts would fancy their chances to post a win here. Australia need wickets and need them quickly to come back in the game. Will they get them though is the question? Meanwhile, it is Nathan Lyon to bowl after the break.
Rizwan comes down the track once more and hits it hard to long off for a single.
Flatter on the pads, pushed to long on for a run by AA.
Lofted over covers for a single by Rizwan.
Flighted outside off, Ali reaches out and pushes it long off for a single.

Huge appeal but turned down! Flatter one going landing on middle, Abid looks to pull but misses. Looks like he was hit in front of the stumps and the ball would have gone on to hit the leg stump. The Aussies though interestingly do not go for a review. The replays later roll on and show us that there was a nick on that. Good decision by Finch not to take it upstairs!
Flatter one on off, Abid defends this to cover.
Adam Zampa is back on now.
Ali pushes this one to covers and runs quickly. The fielder at covers had a shy at the stumps but misses.
Change of length, pulls his length back, pitching on off, Rizwan guides to point. Single added.
FOUR! Pulled away. A short pitch delivery on middle and leg, Rizwan watchfully pulls it towards the square leg region for a boundary. Mohammad Rizwan is playing intelligent cricket here.
Back of a length on off, NCN rolling his finger on this. Rizwan picks this one and pulls it to mid-wicket for a double.
A good length delivery on off, Rizwan strikes it to point.
Full on off, Rizwan punches it to covers.
Another bouncer! Ali ducks under it.
Full on off, defended with ease.
FOUR! Classy! 100-run partnership. A back of a length on off, Ali plays it late towards the third man region for a boundary.
A slower one outside off, Ali looks to guide it towards the third man but fails to connect.
A slower bouncer! Ali does well by ducking under it.
A fuller length delivery on off, Rizwan digs it through covers for a single.
Pulled this time off a length but straight to mid-wicket. 11 runs off this over though and 109 off 102 is the equation now.

FOUR! Edged but Abid will not mind and neither will Pakistan. A length ball outside off, Ali pushes at it trying to drive but the ball flies off the edge and goes to the right of the keeper. A boundary results. He moves into the 90s with this shot.
Short of a length on middle, pulled away by Abid for another couple of runs, this time to the left of Lyon at deep mid-wicket.
On the hips and Abid clips it away off his pads for a couple of runs. Nathan Lyon makes a good diving stop and prevents the boundary.
Run down to third man for a single by MR.

Fuller one on the pads, brilliantly clipped away by Rizwan for a couple of runs and that is his fifty! His fourth in ODIs! The innings has been a calm and composed one and he has given amazing company yo Abid at the other end.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back into the attack.
Full outside off, Rizwan slices it to third man for a single. Another neat over just three from it.
Back of a length in off, Rizwan defends it from the back foot.
A back of a length delivery on middle. Ali pulls it mid-wicket for a single. This seems like an off cutter. Richardson using the slowness of the surface in this bowling.
A back of a length on off, Rizwan punches it covers for a single.
Full on off, Rizwan tries to play this on off side but gets his inside edge on the ball. The ball goes to mid on.
A good length delivery on off, Rizwan drives it straight to the bowler.
A paddle sweep to end the over, Abid finds the fielder at 45 on the leg side. 3 runs off this over. 123 off 114 is the equation now.
Rizwan comes ahead and turns this away to square leg for another run.
Tucked away to mid-wicket for a single by Ali.
Back of a length on off, Ali punches it to covers.
Full on leg, Rizwan flicks it to square leg for a single.
Maxwell fires this one on leg, Rizwan puts it away.

There seems to be a change of the ball here. Looks like it gone out of shape or it is too wet. Do not exactly know what the issue is but the fourth umpire runs out with the box of similarly aged balls.
Run down to third man for a single by Rizwan. He will retain strike for the next over.
Short of a length, pulled away for a single to deep square leg. Good rotation of strike.
A good shot off the back foot by Abid Ali but a dive from the extra cover fielder means he will get his hand to the ball and hence stops a run.

150-up for Pakistan. A strong come back by them. Richardson bowls this on off, Rizwan drives it through covers for single. This partnership is going great and pair have good understanding between them.
Full on leg, Ali flicks this time for a single.
Back of a length on off, Ali pulls it to mid-wicket for a double.
Kane Richardson returns. 3-0-18-0 so far.
A nice tossed up delivery which turns to be full toss for Rizwan. He flicks it long on for a double.
Full length delivery around middle, Ali drives it for a single.
A fuller length on off defended with ease.
Tossed up delivery on leg, Rizwan steps down and plays it mid on for a single.
Well beaten! Length delivery on off. Rizwan fails to connect and gets beaten.
A tossed up delivery on leg, Abid sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Flatter one on middle, defended towards point for a run. Abid keeps strike. He is milking the runs here.
Delicate again! This time the ball is shorter outside off, Abid once more waits the ball and takes the ball almost off the keeper's glove to guide it fine on the off side. 2 runs taken again.
Delicate! Bowled really quick and fast outside off, Ali waits for the ball to come onto his bat before he angles it fine past short third man for a couple of runs.

Catch it is the call but the luck is in Abid's favour! A flatter one on middle, Ali wanted to clear the mid on fielder. He mistimes his pull and it lobs it to the right mid on where Handscomb runs to try and catch it but does not reach the ball in time. No run taken though as the batsmen were ball watching.
Flighted on the pads, Mohammad pats it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Bowled really quick and full outside off, Rizwan drills this through the covers and manages to come back for the second run.

A tossed up delivery on off, Rizwan drives it to mid on for a single. Three runs from this over by Maxwell. Maxwell is bowling around the wicket just to make that angle which is stopping batsmen to play freely.
Floated delivery on off, driven to mid on.
Full on middle, Rizwan steps out of his crease and defends it.
Full on off, defended with ease.
A tossed up delivery on off, Rizwan was looking a heave over covers from his back foot, but fails to get a good connection. The ball goes down to long off for a double.
A full delivery on leg, Rizwan defends it.

FOUR! The perfect end to the over for Pakistan! 10 off it in the end. A flatter one on middle, it goes straight on and Abid slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The fielder in the deep cannot come around to stop it. The dew is sure affecting their spinners here.
This sweep is played fine on the leg side to a flatter one on the pads. Two runs taken as the fielder in deep comes around and stops it just inside the rope.
Not so short for the pull but Ali goes through with the shot. Mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Hit really hard through cover for a couple of runs to the right of deep cover. The 50-run stand comes up between these two.
A flighted one on middle that skids on after landing, Rizwan pats it towards the off side and sets off for a quick single.
Flatter one on the pads, worked away to deep fine leg for a single by Abid.
A tossed up delivery, Abid Ali lifts it towards the long on region for a single. Just two runs from this over. A neat over by Glenn Maxwell.
Back of a length, angling in for Ali. Abid goes on the back foot and easily defends it.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Ali blocks it.
A quicker one outside off, beats Abid who was looking to play it to the third man region.
Full on leg, Ali blocks it.
Back of a length on off, Rizwan rocks back and cuts it covers for a single.
A change of ends for Maxwell.
Full on off, Rizwan taps and takes a single.
A quicker one by Zampa. Full on middle and leg, Rizwan tries a defense gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Ali paddles it to fine leg for a single. Just way too much effort for a single.
A flatter delivery by Zampa, Ali defends it with ease.
A good length delivery on off, Rizwan paddles it to fine leg. Single added.
A nice flighted delivery on leg, Abid tries for a heave above long on, but gets an inside edge onto the fine leg region for a single.
Adam Zampa is back on.
Fuller in length around off, Rizwan fails to connect the bat with the ball.
Back of a length on off, Abid goes on the back foot, waits for the ball to come to him and then cuts it to covers for a single.
A floated delivery on off, Abid defends it.
Full on off, Abid blocks it to point.
A tossed up delivery on off. Rizwan dances down the track to kill any turn on the delivery and flicks it to mid on for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Abid Ali drives it mid on for a single.
Worked off the pads for a single to deep square leg. A single off every delivery this over. Brilliant batting.
Full toss on the pads, swept to deep fine leg for a run by MR.
The sweep comes out this time from Abid but the ball is too close to the short fine leg fielder. A single is taken as there is a slight misfield.
Cut away to deep cover for a single.
Flatter on the off stump line, once more a quick single is taken as Abid nudges it towards square leg.
Flatter one on middle, Rizwan pats it towards the leg side and steals a quick run.
Glenn Maxwell into the attack now.
Full on off, Rizwan grabs a single by taping it to point.
Full on off, Rizwan pushes it to covers.
Shorter length this time by Lyon, Ali pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slight hold in play here... Rizwan seems to have hurt himself while putting in a dive. Taking a while to compose himself.

Back of a length on off, Rizwan taps it to mid-wicket for a quick single. Maxwell at mid-wicket has a shy at the bowler's end. Batsman puts a successful dive to save himself. Lyon collects the ball. The replays show the direct hit would have been curtains for Mohammad Rizwan.
Full on middle, defended
A floated delivery on off, Abid paddles it fine towards the fine leg region for a single.

FOUR! Third boundary of the over! A flatter one on the pads, slightly fuller than the previous occasion. Rizwan gets the sweep out once more and hits it in the gap for a boundary. 15 runs off this over and the 100 comes up for Pakistan!
Flatter one on middle, defended off the front foot by Mohammad.
SIX! The slog over cow corner this time and it goes beyond the boundary. A flatter one on middle, Finch is firing them in and Rizwan was ready and deposits it into the crowd.
FOUR! Flighted on middle, Rizwan brings out the sweep once more. He nails it and gets it in the gap through square leg for a boundary.

Pushed down to long on and that is a fifty on debut! Brilliant innings so far from Abid Ali but he will know that a lot has to be done and he needs to carry on to make a big one here. He has looked really compact in his stroke play.
Flighted on middle, Abid keeps it out watchfully.

FOUR! Another sweep shot. This was tossed up nicely on middle and leg, Mohammad Rizwan sweeps it nicely towards the mid-wicket region for another boundary from the over. 8 runs from this over with help of both boundaries.
A flighted delivery, Rizwan dances down the track and then pads it.
A flighted delivery, Rizwan blocks it.
Full on off, defends it with ease.
Flatter delivery on off, Rizwan defends it.
FOUR! A nice tossed up delivery on off, Rizwan plays a nice sweep towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Cut away for a single to end the over. Rizwan will face the first ball of the next over.
Good ball! The arm ball outside off, Rizwan looks to push it to cover but fails to do so in the end. It was really close to the outside edge.
Shorter one on middle, pulled to the right of long on for a single by Ali. He moves onto 49.
Hurled in quicker on middle, Rizwan drives it down to long on and gets off the mark.
A flatter one on middle, Rizwan pulls this ball to mid-wicket where Stoinis makes a tumbling stop.
Bowled with flight on the off stump, pushed to deep cover for a single by Abid.
Aaron Finch to roll his arm over now.
Full on off, defended by staying in crease.
Rizwan steps down again. Lyon flights this one on off, Rizwan dances down the track and flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Rizwan steps down the track on his very first delivery and plays this straight to the bowler.

Drinks break. The fall of a wicket just before the break has caused the 74-run stand to come to an end. Abid Ali has looked very confident in his first innings and was provided good support by Haris Sohail who wasn't especially in great flow. He has fallen now though and given an opening for the Aussies to pick up a few more. Pakistan would like the new batsman coming in to stitch another 50-plus stand at least with Abid. Let's see if that happens. It will be Mohammad Rizwan who comes out to the middle now.

OUT! Haris Sohail departs. A fuller delivery on off, Sohail looks for a drive and plays it with hard hands. The ball flies straight into the hand of Maxwell at covers. Lyon bowled this one applying a nice loop on it, as he was getting good purchase from this wicket. And he uses it to break this stand.
A back of a length on off, Sohail gets into position early which allow him to play the ball anywhere, he flicks it mid-wicket for a double.
A quicker on to begin this over, pitching on off. Sohail defends it.
Sohail comes down the track to this one flighted outside off and hits it wide of deep cover for a single.
Really full and bowled on the middle and leg stump line. Haris dead-bats the ball to the leg side.
Abid has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Oooh! That could have been risky. A flatter one on middle, Ali closes his bat trying for a flick. The ball takes the leading edge and goes to the off side.
Quicker one bowled around off, a block from Abid Ali follows.
Clipped through mid-wicket to the flatter one on middle. Single taken.
Flighted outside off, punched down to long off for a single by Sohail.
This time the ball goes to the left of the square leg fielder. A run is taken.
Flatter one on the middle stump line, turned to square leg. No run though.
A floated delivery on middle and leg, Sohail drives it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length on off, Sohail punches it to cover.
A nice tossed up delivery on off, Sohail fails to put his bat on the ball. Lyon getting nice turn and bounce from track.
A googly to end the over, bowled flatter outside off. The batsman comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Shorter and wide outside off, Abid rocks back and cuts the ball but fails to find the gap. Looks disappointed to have missed out there.
Full on off, defended with ease.
Sohail charges down the track, Zampa notices it and pulls is length short. Haris Sohail plays it straight to bowler. Misfield by Zampa allows a single.
A tossed up delivery on leg, Ali flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A back of length delivery on leg, Sohail flicks it to mid-wicket.
A back of a length on off, Abid Ali plays it late from his back foot and cuts it to the point region for a double.
A back of a length, Sohail this time waits on his back foot and flicks it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length on off, Sohail cuts it to covers.
Fuller length on off, Sohail blocks it.
Full on off, Sohail defends it.
Lyon bowls this one on off, Ali waits for the ball to come to him and then works towards the fine leg region for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Ali flicks it mid-wicket for a single.
A tossed up delivery by Zampa, Sohail wrists it for a single.
A quicker and flatter one by Zampa. Ali works it to leg side for a single.
A leg spinner on off, Sohail punches it to covers for a single.
A back of a length on off, Sohail tries for a cut but fails.
A flighted delivery on off, Sohail blocks it. Nice start from Zampa.
Adam Zampa comes on to bowl now.
Sohail punches this off the back foot towards cover and the fielder there, Stoinis makes a half-stop. A run is stolen though.
Abid stands tall and pushes it to the left of point for a single with soft hands.

Loud appeal but the umpire is unmoved! A short one outside off, Ali was lining up for the cut but the ball turns into him and catches him on the pad. There seems to be a slight inside edge before the ball hit the pad. Hence, there was no discussion of taking a review by Australia.
Abid works it towards square leg off the pads but no run there.
Bowled quicker on middle, pushed away by the southpaw for a run through mid-wicket.
Flatter one on the pads, flicked away for a single to deep square leg.
Powerplay 2 time! Four players can be outside the circle till the 40th over now. Meanwhile, Nathan Lyon has come on to bowl.
Back of a length on off, defended with ease. End of Powerplay 1. Australia are 52/1.
Full on off Sohail blocks it.
50-up for Pakistan with this double at mid-wicket. Batsmen shakes hands with each other as this brings 50-run stand between them as well.
A back of a length delivery on off, Sohail blocks it.
Same length on off, Sohail punches it to mid off.
A short of a good length delivery on middle and leg, Ali flicks it mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Where is the slip, Mr.Finch? A length ball outside off, Sohail pushes at it without foot movement and hence the ball takes the outside edge and flies through the vacant slip region for a boundary. Unlucky for NCN, good bowling!
Back of a length on off, Sohail punches it to covers.
A good bouncer! Well ducked by Sohail.
A back of a length on off, Sohail defends it from his back foot.
Length delivery on leg, Haris flicks it upplishly to mid-wicket for a double.
Good length ball on off, Haris blocks it.
Full on leg, Ali puts it away.
Stoinis goes down the leg this time, Ali flicks it to mid-wicket and adds a double to score.
A back of a length delivery on off, Ali punches it to covers.
Change of line by Stoinis this time, on middle Ali just blocks it.
Back of a length on leg, Ali flicks it to mid-wicket.
Wide. Stoinis drifts down leg side on this.
FOUR! Top shot from Ali. Stoinis starts bowling this one short of a good length and Abid Ali pulls it towards the mid-wicket region. Khawaja in the deep tries to stop with a dive but fails.
Marcus Stoinis to bowl now.
A length ball from around the wicket, kept out towards the mid-wicket fielder by Sohail.
A pull off the front foot and the ball goes to deep backward square leg for another run.
Aimed at the hips, flicked off the body for a single by Sohail.
A fuller length ball outside off, pushed to point by the southpaw.

Oooh! Close but lands short of the mid-wicket fielder. A length ball on middle, Sohail looks to flick this but it goes slightly in the air. Handscomb at mid-wicket comes running in for the catch but the ball is well short of him in the end.
Short of a length on top of middle, pulled away for a single to deep mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Haris comes ahead and pushes it towards mid off.
This time the flick is there but the ball goes a more towards deep backward square leg. The fielder at the deep ensures that only 1 run is taken.
Flicked through the vacant mid-wicket region for a couple of runs this time.
FOUR! The wrong line from Kane and Abid takes full toll. Hops inside the line and puts it past short fine leg for a beautiful boundary.
The whole cordon of fielders on the off side is being tested by this new guy. A length ball outside off, Abid punches it firmly but the cover fielder does well to dive and save runs.
Bowled on a length and on top of off stump, defended with a solid presentation of the straight bat by Abid.
Short one from NCN to end the over, Abid pulls it along the ground to deep square leg and keeps strike.
This guy is striking the ball cleanly. This cut would have been the fourth boundary of the over if not for Maxwell at point. Saves 4 runs there surely.
FOUR! Off the back foot this time! A length ball outside off, Ali rocks back in his crease and cuts this one through cover-point. No stopping those.
Another drive through the covers but this time the ball is too close to the fielder.
FOUR! Classic cover drive! Right from the textbook. A length ball outside off, Abid makes perfect foot movement and finds the gap through the covers. Brilliant shot!
On the pads, worked away for a single to the leg side.
Misfield! A short ball wide outside off, cut away hard by Abid. The point fielder makes a half-stop but cannot prevent 2 runs from being taken by the Pakistan batsmen.
Almost another boundary if not for a ridiculous save! A fuller ball flicked with superb timing by Abid, the mid-wicket fielder though dives and makes a terrific stop. Saved 4 runs there surely.

FOUR! This time he find the middle of the bat as well as the gap! A short length ball on middle, Abid swivels and pulls it in front of square leg for a boundary. This guy looks more than a decent bat!
Bowled at the body of the batsman, Abid pulls it but straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Abid is ahead to defend this one but the ball comes off the bottom of the bat. Kept a little low too!
Defended off the front foot by Abid Ali presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Ali waits for this on his back foot and then flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off, Ali defends this one.
A back of a length on leg, Sohail flicks from his pads to square leg for a single.
A short pitch delivery, testing the newbie. Coulter Nile bowls this with good pace on leg. Ali pulls it for a single.
Haris grabs a single on this one. He pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Angled away from Haris. Sohail taps it to covers from his back foot.
Full on off, defended.
A fuller length delivery on off, Ali blocks it.
Full on off, defended by Ali.
A juicy half volley on off, Ali dives it to covers and takes a double.
Full on leg, Abid Ali opens his account by flicking it to mid-wicket for a double.
Wide! Full on middle and leg with angling in, but the ball drifts down the leg for a wide.
Richardson starts with back of a length on off, angling in. Abid Ali defends it.
Kane Richardson to bowl from the other end, with the other new ball.
Sohail pushes this to cover watchfully. End of the successful first over, a wicket maiden!
Haris Sohail is the next batsman.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Masood departs! Dragged on to his stumps and he has not troubled the scorers. A length ball outside off, Shan pushes at it without any foot movement. He gets an inside edge due to the very slight inward movement off the surface and the ball goes on to knock back the middle stump. A dejected Masood walks off. Nothing going right for the hosts but it is the perfect start for the Aussies!
Fuller length delivery on off, Masood defends with full face of the bat.
Full outside off, Shan tries for a drive but gets beaten.
A back of a length on middle and off, Masood just guides to point.
Bowls this one on a length outside off and shaping away, the southpaw Shan leaves the ball alone.

We are back for the chase. That was barely even a break. New opening pair for Pakistan tonight - Shan Masood and one of the two debutants - ABID ALI. Nathan Coulter-Nile will start off proceedings with the first new ball. Masood to face. Here we go...
